name: print-social-story-new-era-orange-teal-orb-hexagon
title: 'New Era' story with orange/teal orb and hexagon accents
whatItIs: A companion story template from the same futuristic set, featuring a large split orange/teal circular orb, thin orbital ring lines, and a smaller hexagon shape below the 'NEW ERA' headline.
whatItMeans: A split-color orb divided cleanly down the middle visually suggests duality or transformation, fitting the 'new era' messaging without any literal imagery.
techniques: split a single circular shape into two contrasting gradient halves to suggest transformation
add thin orbital ring lines around a central shape to imply motion/orbit
pair one large focal shape with a smaller secondary shape of a different geometry for variety

vocabulary.definition: a thin circular line drawn around a shape to suggest rotation, orbit or energy
